The derivative of the backward logit transform

inv_logit_grad.Rd

The derivative of inv_logit() with respect to z. As unsqueeze() is affine in p with slope n / (n - 1), and d plogis(z) / dz = p * (1 - p), the chain rule gives (b - a) * n / (n - 1) * p * (1 - p).

Usage

inv_logit_grad(z, a, b, n)

Arguments

z

a vector of numerical values

a

the min value of the training set

b

the max value of the training set

n

the number of samples in the training set
